records.name: gate.cat

records.description: ReviewQRPro is a free QR code toolkit for businesses and creators. Generate QR codes for Google Reviews, websites, WhatsApp, WiFi, social media, contact cards, documents, and more—no sign-up required. Fast, simple, and browser-based.

records.name: Syntech Metals Limited
records.tagline: aluminum extrusion profiles factory china
records.description: Syntech Metals is Top Custom Aluminum Extrusion Profiles Factory in China, Supply premium aluminum extrusion profiles for Construction, Industrial, Automation applications. Get Custom CNC Machining, Anodizing, and Powder coating services, and a free profile catalog quote.

records.name: KeyTunes for Spotify
records.tagline: Control Spotify with hotkeys, without tabbing out
records.description: KeyTunes is a lightweight Windows tray app for controlling Spotify without switching windows. Unlike tools that scrape window titles or require Spotify Premium + OAuth, KeyTunes hooks directly into Windows' native Audio Session (WASAPI) and Media Transport Controls — the same system your keyboard's media keys use. That means: works on Free accounts, survives Spotify updates, and zero telemetry

records.name: Colony Flow! Guide
records.tagline: Every Colony Flow! level solved: video walkthroughs + tips
records.description: # Colony Flow! Guide The complete fan-made guide hub for the hit pixel puzzle game. **What it is** - 🎥 Video walkthroughs for all 398 levels - 🧩 Proven, board-by-board strategies - ⚡ Quick answers when a level fights back **Why we built it** Colony Flow! is deceptively tricky — a board that looks solved can still trap you. This hub collects every level solution in one place so players never hit a dead end. **Links** - Full guides & videos: https://www.colony-flow.org/

records.name: OMNIMIND™ – AI Prompt System
records.tagline: The organized system for better AI prompts
records.description: OMNIMIND™ is a structured prompt system — 150+ ready prompts, an AI Prompt Builder, and guided workflows — that gets you consistent, expert-level results from ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, without learning prompt engineering.

records.name: SplitFlow
records.tagline: Effortless expense splitting for families & group trips.
records.description: Forget spreadsheet headaches on group trips. SplitFlow lets you split costs fairly based on family size (adults/kids) and actual bank exchange rates—100% free with zero account creation required. Share a simple 6-character code to track and settle expenses together in real-time.

records.name: LiveFonty
records.tagline: A Chrome Extension to Preview Google Fonts on any webpage.
records.description: Search 1,900+ Google Fonts and preview them live on any webpage. Free to install, no signup. Fonts apply in your browser only.

records.name: doSimple Bot
records.tagline: Turns chaos from Telegram channels into a 2-minute podcast
records.description: doSimple Bot is your personal AI Telegram agent that cures information overload. Tired of scrolling through ads and duplicate news? doSimple parses your selected channels, strips out spam, and converts the noise into structured 2-minute audio & text digests. Powered by a 0-latency Smart Database Cache, it delivers instant summaries without LLM wait times. Stop scrolling and start listening to a clean, personalized news feed on the go. Reclaim your time today!

records.name: RZ - Powerd by movement
records.tagline: One Platform. Unified Action. Limitless Connection.
records.description: Radical RZ is revolutionizing extreme sports by uniting athletes, communities, sponsors, and organizers into a single connected ecosystem. By fusing cutting-edge technology with real-time participation—from synchronized global challenges to off-grid mesh tracking—Radical RZ takes extreme sports onto the ultimate digital stage.

records.name: Lacuna
records.tagline: The stuff school skipped, for $1 a topic
records.description: Practical primers on what school skipped — money, contracts, your own habits, and more. Every topic is $1, part 1 always free.

records.name: NeumoStudio AI
records.tagline: 100% Free AI Image Studio & PDF Suite
records.description: NeumoStudio AI is a 100% free visual studio & PDF suite built with soft Neumorphism UI aesthetics. ✨ Key Tools: • Neural AI Background Remover • Exact Target KB PDF Size Compressor (200KB/500KB) • 128-bit AES PDF Password Lock & Unlock • 4x6 Printable Passport Photo Sheet Generator • Magic Object & Watermark Eraser Brush • Image to PDF Merger & Social Resizer No paywalls, no watermark limits, and no account required!

records.name: MyFreud
records.tagline: Your self-help companion
records.description: MyFreud is your AI coach for better mental wellbeing. Track your mood, reflect, and grow with personalised support. Take a quick, free mental-health quiz.

records.name: ClariLayer
records.tagline: AI context layer for analysts
records.description: ClariLayer is a context layer that connects with any AI you use day to day, so you have durable context about you data, metrics, analysis, etc. The context is durable, cross-sessions and cross-tools, so you will never need to re-explain your data.

records.name: Datplan DataPull
records.tagline: Pull business data privately and build reusable reports
records.description: Datplan DataPull helps accountants, finance teams and consultants stop rebuilding the same reporting spreadsheets every month. It pulls authorised business data directly to a Windows device, prepares reporting-ready tables, creates dashboards, schedules refreshes and exports data for Excel, Power BI and other BI tools—without requiring a separate cloud reporting warehouse.

records.name: My Blog
records.tagline: What is a Regular B.Sc. College?
records.description: Book Counselling session STUDENTS ENROLLED 20 K+ SPECIALIZATION 20 K+ EXPERT COUNSELORS 20 K+ TOP UNIVERSITY 20 K+ Why choose us ? We are committed to ensuring that your dream to study abroad for both professional and personal growth becomes a reality. At Shiksha Planets, we assist you in achieving your career goals and making […]

records.name: Smile-O Flow
records.tagline: The complete oral care routine, re-engineered into 3 minutes
records.description: Smile-O combines a slim sonic toothbrush with AeroFloss Pro, an electric interdental cleaner powered by 31,000 vibrations per minute. One portable system turns brushing and the part most people skip into a complete 3-minute daily routine.

records.name: The Complete Toolkit Bundle
records.tagline: 6 tools that turn vague problems into clear numbers
records.description: This bundle brings together everything I've built so far: 🪧 Digital Cork Board — an interactive notes board + printable version 🎒 Adventure Packing List — 82 items, 8 categories, live weight tracker 🩺 Physician Offer Comparison — compare job offers with a weighted match score ✦ AI Prompt Library — 50+ structured prompts across 10 categories 💰 Freelancer Rate Calculator — find your real minimum hourly rate 🎯 FreedomPlan — calculates your exact debt-free date, Snowball vs Avalanche No login

records.name: Polished.page
records.tagline: Turn Markup AI text into beautiful, publish-ready documents
records.description: Stop fighting document formatting. Polished.page turns AI-generated Markdown into professional, publish-ready documents with beautiful themes, live paginated preview, cover pages, tables of contents, Mermaid diagrams, images and PDF export. Write with ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor, choose a publication theme, and produce documents that look professionally designed instead of manually formatted.

records.name: Edgewise Lab
records.tagline: Catch what breaks AI-built apps before you launch
records.description: Free, open-source tool that checks your AI-built app and tells you, in plain English, what is not safe to launch yet.

records.name: FasoCompta
records.tagline: Fasocompta est une solution de gestion intelligente
records.description: FasoCompta : POS, stock, factures, comptabilité SYSCOHADA et paie pour entreprises africaines. Mode hors-ligne. Essai gratuit 7 jours.

records.name: Habit Forge
records.tagline: Build streaks,compete,level up your life—one habit at a time
records.description: HabitForge is a social habit tracker that makes building good habits actually fun. Track your daily streaks, challenge friends, earn XP for completing real-life habits, and watch your personal growth gamify itself. No fluff. Just habits, streaks, and friendly competition.

records.name: STEP Reviewer Pro
records.tagline: For 100MB+ · 1M+ Facets
records.description: Built for CAD review: STEP files in the hundreds of MB and faceted models above 1 million triangles, plus measurement, cross sections, and mesh export.

records.name: AssurePlus
records.tagline: Enterprise AI GRC software built for modern teams
records.description: AssurePlus is an AI-powered GRC platform that helps you manage risk, compliance, and audits in one place. Book a Demo Today!

records.name: WavToMP3
records.tagline: Convert WAV to MP3 privately in your browser — no uploads.
records.description: Convert WAV to MP3 for free in your browser. Compress large WAV files into smaller MP3s with 128–320 kbps quality. No upload, account, or software download required.

records.name: Cravio
records.tagline: 每个青少年都会用AI创造世界
records.description: Cravio is an AI creativity education platform for kids aged 10–15. Instead of teaching code line by line, we skip the tool bottleneck and train what coding never could — defining problems, breaking them down, controlling AI outputs, and iterating with feedback. Cravio is a turnkey system with teacher training, assessments, and ready-to-use materials built in.

records.name: Comedy in R&B

records.description: Comedy in rap Nelly vs Africa

records.name: My Earth
records.tagline: #plantscanner
records.description: This is an app which scans the plants strength and tells what they require to grow and this app identifies the plants name. And tells how to grow the plants.

records.name: Vela
records.tagline: The AI Recruiting Coordinator
records.description: Vela is an AI recruiting coordinator. Cc it on any email thread and it takes over: candidate screens, multi-round loops, and full panels. It offers times, chases people who go quiet, handles reschedules, sends the resume with the invite, books prep calls, and collects feedback. Email, SMS, WhatsApp, Slack, and phone, every time zone, 24/7. No links, no logins, nothing new for your team to learn. Trusted by The World's Best Recruiters, and backed by YC, CRV, and other incredible investors.
